mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real GDP growth signals a weakening economy that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings estimates are revised downward.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market and consumer demand that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in triggered periods than non-triggered (t-test p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals a strengthening economy that will produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next month as corporate earnings estimates are revised upward.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening housing market and consumer demand that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in triggered periods than non-triggered (t-test p > 0.05)

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in real consumer spending signals a strengthening economy that will produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next month as corporate earnings estimates are revised upward.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in payroll employment signals a strengthening labor market and consumer demand that will produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 30% of months despite positive signal

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the CPI inflation rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed is forced to raise rates.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower when CPI is rising rapidly than when it is stable (t-test p > 0.1)
